svg.title: Guide-word scenes: F-05 Driver information and warnings under its SC guide words (WP-C-03 §4), phone view
svg.desc: 8 cards for F-05 Driver information and warnings, one per SC guide word. M01 No Function: H-07, SG-02/SG-06 ASIL C; callout: crosses edge line. M02 Stops Functioning: H-07, SG-02/SG-06 ASIL C, covered by M01; callout: crosses edge line. M04 Function Stuck: H-07, SG-02/SG-06 ASIL C; callout: crosses edge line. M06 Partial Function: H-07, SG-02/SG-06 ASIL C, covered by M01; callout: driver corrects late. M08 Functions Late: H-07, SG-02/SG-06 ASIL C, covered by M01; callout: driver corrects late. M09 Function Applies Too Short: H-07, SG-02/SG-06 ASIL C, covered by M01; callout: crosses edge line. M11 Function is Delayed: H-07, SG-02/SG-06 ASIL C, covered by M01; callout: driver corrects late. M12 Inverse Function: H-07, SG-02/SG-06 ASIL C, covered by M04; callout: crosses edge line.

vs performed. Scene: what it does to the car.
